description: Dependency updates are merged automatically once the PR Check workflow passes.
Every merge to master triggers the Release workflow, which ships a new patch release.

packageRules.description: Wait a few days before taking new npm releases, to avoid bad or compromised publishes.
One weekly PR with every non-major update (minor, patch, digest, including 0.x packages), auto-merged when the build check passes.
One weekly PR with every major update. Never auto-merged: majors usually need code changes.
The demo parser library has to follow CS2 game updates: update as soon as a release appears, in its own PR.
Leave runner images alone: the Windows jobs are pinned to windows-2022 on purpose (newer images ship a Visual Studio that node-gyp 10 cannot detect).
